import sqlite3
import csv
import sys

def generate_user_report(db_path, output_file):
    """Generate CSV report of all users from database."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Get table name from command line argument
    table_name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'users'
    
    # Execute query with dynamic table name
    query = f"SELECT id, username, email, password_hash, created_at FROM {table_name}"
    cursor.execute(query)
    
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    
    # Write to CSV
    with open(output_file, 'w', newline='') as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(['ID', 'Username', 'Email', 'Password Hash', 'Created'])
        writer.writerows(rows)
    
    conn.close()
    print(f"Report generated: {output_file}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    generate_user_report('internal.db', 'user_report.csv')
